name: ibima-callcenter-service
description: Backend for the IBima Assist Call Center / Claim Management portal (car-damage-insurance-callcenter): intimation, handler & surveyor assignment, claim details, Documents DMS, AI ILA review, Handler ILA, payment recommendation, survey paybill, letters and communication history. Users sign in with the accounts created in Admin > Create Users (admin-service). Own folder, port, database file and PM2 process.
